label: Fires at GO after a2 reached rare S1 and was rewarded, stronger mid-episode and when S2 believed good.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (ep_trial > 9) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1)
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (ep_trial > 9) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_cover
explanation: Active only at GO, almost only when the previous trial was a2 -> rare S1 -> rewarded (that indicator alone gives dev R^2 0.36 beyond timing). Within those steps, magnitude is larger after the first ~10 trials of the episode, larger when the ideal observer believes S2 is good (negative belief_lo; a model-based agent would stick with a2 here), and larger when the trial before was also rewarded. Silent at D1 and D2. The free fit (also a2-before-last and belief_cover) adds very little (test 0.473 vs 0.472). A future stay term adds nothing (dev 0.487), so it was not used. The rest of the unexplained variance is mostly GO firing on a window first trial, where the previous trial is not in the window and so cannot be scored.

issues: Minor: the label says 'stronger mid-episode', but the (ep_trial > 9) term actually gates the feature. When the plain indicator and the ep_trial>9 version are fitted together, the plain indicator gets weight 0.0016 and the ep_trial>9 version 0.117, so the feature is close to silent after a2-S1-rewarded trials in the first ~10 trials. That term adds only about +0.016 test R^2 (0.456 without it vs 0.472 with it).

Most of the magnitude claim rests on the belief term: indicator alone 0.336 test, plus belief_lo 0.449. Its weight is negative (-0.029 to -0.035), which confirms 'stronger when S2 is believed good'. The previous trial's reward adds less (0.336 to 0.385 when it is the only addition).

belief_cover adds nothing (0.3367 vs 0.3363), as claimed. Variants for the third term all score lower on test than reward two trials back (0.472): state two back == S2 0.471, since_rev 0.467, action two back == a2 0.467, raw belief in place of belief_lo 0.458.

misses: no systematic class by phase x previous trial (all within about ±0.004). The worst windows are GO firing on a window's first trial, where the previous trial is outside the window, as the explanation says. A second group is high-amplitude firing (~0.37) predicted at only ~0.17-0.19, which is a scale shortfall rather than a missed condition.
The profile confirms the feature is silent at D1 and D2 (residual exactly 0), and GO residual is +0.109 only after a2 S1 r.
skeptic.revised_label: Fires at GO after a2 reached rare S1 and was rewarded (not early in episode); stronger when S2 believed good.
